source_record.title: Senior Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails (f/m/d)
source_record.description:
Are you ready to change the market?

At PAIR Finance we're building the AI-driven platform that's redefining debt collection across Europe. We're looking for a senior software engineer who takes ownership end-to-end, is comfortable being the technical driver of a well-defined scope, and is energized by learning a deep, high-stakes domain: the legal processes around In-Court and After-Court debt collection.


Your Responsibilities:

  • Own a clear scope end-to-end: take initiative from idea to production largely independently, and lead within your team (T-shaped: you go deep on your slice, and pair with one other developer)
  • Design, build, and run POCs quickly to de-risk decisions before committing to a full build
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain our core backend applications and services
  • Work on high-level architecture to ensure scalability, performance, availability, and security
  • Go deep on the In-Court/After-Court domain (the legal and procedural knowledge behind our
    collection processes is a core part of the job, not a side detail) 
  • Collaborate closely with product to shape the roadmap and unlock further company growth
  • Work AI-augmented: you already use (or are ready to adopt) tools like Claude Code as part of how you build, review, and ship
  • Help evolve and enhance our AI-based platform
  • Stay current with industry trends and bring ideas back to the team


What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 1+ year on medium-to-large
    projects
  • Strong backend experience in Ruby (Ruby on Rails): this is our core stack, and required for the
    role
  • Language-agnostic mindset: you pick the right tool for the job (hands-on experience with Go and/or Python is a big plus) 
  • Proven ability to work independently: scope, drive, and deliver a project with minimal hand-holding
  • Experience with TDD and CI/CD
  • A track record of writing clean, maintainable backend code and solid infrastructure
  • Comfortable in an Agile environment (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Genuine interest in working with, and building on top of, AI-based technologies
  • Solid English communication skills
Nice to have:
  • Experience in the financial or accounting industry 
  • Frontend development experience, especially Vue.js and GraphQL knowledge
  • Infrastructure experience: AWS, Terraform (IaC), Docker, Linux

  • Knowledge of other backend technologies, such as Node.js, Rust, or Java


Our offer for you:

  • For this senior-level role, our salary band is €77,000 - €92,000 gross per year (based on a 40-hour work week). The exact offer will reflect your experience and qualifications
  • We offer visa sponsorship
  • Thriving, financially stable company
  • Strong experienced international team to support and mentor you along the way, smooth onboarding process
  • International team of 30+ nationalities with professionals and experts
  • Flat hierarchy, transparent and appreciative feedback culture, monthly all hands meetings, annual feedback and evaluation cycle, regular 1-on-1s with your lead
  • Well-structured onboarding process as well as supportive and welcoming colleagues
  • Personal learning & development budget as well as German and English language courses
  • Unlimited employment contract, flexible working hours and 28 vacation days for your work-life balance
  • Company pension plan, partly covered Deutschlandticket (public transport) and access to “Corporate Benefits”-voucher platform to ensure your full well-being
  • Fun company summer and Christmas parties as well as regular team events
  • This role is based in Berlin, and we have a hybrid working policy. Modern office near Uhlandstr. is complete with fresh fruit, muesli and drinks for a comfortable and enjoyable workplace


Who is your contact person?

Your contact person for this position is Geneva Brooks. If you have any questions, please contact us directly by email ----- - we look forward to hearing from you!

For more information about PAIR Finance, please take a look at our website and our careers page.
